notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where pause menu sometimes gets locked.
[*] Speed up time now automatically turns off if you stop moving. 
[*] Character Names can now be saved. 
[*] Change character from in game pause menu. 
[*] Notepad no longer holds focus after text is committed. 
[*] Characters stats are tracked, including personal best times per exercise. 
[/list]

notes.title: Training Update
notes.content:
Game now includes text-based training lessons.

Much more is planned for the training, but this is a good start.

notes.title: Training Update
notes.content: Many training lessons have been added to the game.

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix 001
notes.content: Hotfix for audio sliders not working correctly and notepad buttons not working.
